Calls posing as a judge or jail official tell families an inmate (New Mexico, Socorro County) can be released and driven home for a payment of up to $1,000
Calls, texts and emails posing as We Energies (Wisconsin) threaten immediate power shutoff unless paid now by gift card, crypto, payment app or QR code

SMS posing as Guyana Traffic Police offer a 50% traffic-fine discount if paid within 24 hours, threaten court, and link to fake payment sites

Calls posing as named Moore County (North Carolina) Sheriff staff cite a subpoena, DNA test or a jailed relative and demand bond or release-program payment, often by gift card

Wiltshire Police: calls spoofing the police 101 number pose as detectives and ask for your bank account details
Marlboro County (South Carolina) Sheriff's Office: calls and letters posing as law enforcement claim an outstanding warrant or pending arrest and demand payment to clear it

Honduras National Police: fake website posing as the official police portal offers driver's licence and traffic-ticket procedures at a 'discount' with a same-day payment deadline, taking payment and account/banking access
